comment: Who may appear as a contributor to this repository. GitHub builds the Contributors list from two independent things: the commit AUTHOR, and every Co-Authored-By trailer. Both are governed here. Anyone not matched is stripped (trailers) or reattributed (authors) by the commit-msg and pre-commit hooks and by Commit Trailer Guard. Matching is case-insensitive; an identity matches if its email equals an `email` entry or its name matches a `namePattern` regex.

reattributeTo.comment: A disallowed author is rewritten to this identity rather than the commit being rejected. The work was done on the owner's behalf, so the owner is who it belongs to.
